$comment: THE INHERITED REGRESSION NET, AND WHAT LEFT IT — criterion E3.
E3: "The inherited regression net is green, OR every failure is a deliberate, ADR-recorded
consequence of a spec change. A GREEN SUITE AFTER A SPEC CHANGE IS TREATED AS MORE SUSPICIOUS
That sentence is why this file exists. The ordinary way a suite goes green after a spec change
is that somebody deleted the tests that failed — and a deletion and a repair look identical in
a summary line. The only thing that tells them apart is a record naming the ADR that
authorised it and what replaced it.
The baseline was MEASURED, not remembered: the whole suite replayed in a worktree at the
commit before any P2 work touched this repository.

baseline.atSubject: Session 06: Batch-1 cost model shipped, contract v1.2 and v1.3, OD-21 closed
baseline.measuredBy: jest --ci replayed in a detached worktree at that commit

removed.why: It tested the DataAuthorityAdapter singleton, which P2 criterion D3 requires gone: OD-20 makes the pipeline's adapter the only supported way to read a pack, and a local singleton over bundled JSON is the reimplementation OD-20 forbids in as many words.

It asserted that the app's bundled JSON was NOT authoritative — a true and useful statement about a path that no longer exists. The app now reads signed packs through the adapter, and the equivalent question is answered by verifying them.
It exercised the legacy read path end to end, including card_rates.json and fxAbroad.v2.json, both of which D3 removed. An integration test of a deleted integration cannot be repaired, only replaced.

It tested a hook over the local SQLite rates mirror. B3 splits storage into an encrypted vault and a pack store, and D2 forbids anything outside data/adapter/** from touching the DB driver, so the hook it tested is a shape the boundary rules now refuse.

$closedNote: 17 tests left with those four files. Anything below 410 - 17 without a matching record is a
suite that lost tests nobody accounted for, and the `regression` gate fails on it.
No entry is marked FAILING_DELIBERATELY. E3 permits a red suite only where every failure is
recorded here; today the suite is green and this register accounts only for deletions.
